nodes.title: Marking a closed-answer verdict as played when her reply STARTS (audit V-09): broke 'fast mouth, late verdict' (her uptake sounds before the verdict word, and a correction then must still revoke). Kept instead: revocable until max(her start, verdictNotBefore) + REVOCABLE_MS

The thinking-pause cue (voicesig round 3) is not subscribed by the live hands-free engine (src/duplex/liveTap.ts): it had gone live when hands-free became every child's default, against r3vs-holdcue-shadow (shadow until a children's pilot). Main's decision on audit V-22

The expressive SSML delivery plan is OFF by default on DragonHD (TAXILA_VOICE_EXPRESSIVE=1 turns it on), matching rj-ssml-delivery-plan-2026-10-04 (listeners preferred the plain line). Owner call to confirm or to run the pending blind listen (audit V-27)

Record correction (audit V-29): rs7-voice-switch (server/voice/voice-switch.js) and rs7-translit-roman-to-devanagari (server/voice/translit) are recorded as wired; no live code path calls voice-switch's styleFor/synthesize or toDevanagari. Both stay unwired by main's decision. 'bara' removed from the twelve hand entries (it is बड़ा, big; NUMBER_AMBIG keeps it as twelve in a number context)

Deleted under RULES2 (audit V-39): server/voice/expressive/compile/mai.js and server/voice/expressive/compile/omni.js (no engine, route or script used them; one test did). Last commit that holds both: 634e125b

md.rejected:
## `rj-r7-audit-voice-verdict-at-her-start`

**Tried:** (audit V-09) nothing in the app sends the governor's `her_verdict`, so a closed-answer reply stayed revocable for its whole length and a "हाँ" four seconds in cut it. First fix: mark the verdict played when her reply starts.

**What broke:** `tests/duplex-runtime.test.mjs` "G7 revoke … (fast mouth, late verdict)": her uptake sounds BEFORE the verdict word (verdictNotBefore is after her start), and a child correction in that gap must still revoke.

**Instead:** revocable until `max(herStartAt, verdictNotBefore) + REVOCABLE_MS` (1.5 s), or until `her_verdict` if anything ever sends it.
md.decisions:
## `dc-r7-audit-voice-holdcue-unsubscribed`

`src/duplex/liveTap.ts` no longer subscribes `live.estimate` to `holdBus.onThinkingPause`. The cue still publishes for its counters. Main's decision on audit V-22: `r3vs-holdcue-shadow` says shadow until a children's pilot, and the recorded trial prevented 0 of 12 cut-offs and delayed one turn by 2.0 s.

**Reverse when** a children's pilot shows the cue prevents cut-offs without delaying turns.

## `dc-r7-audit-voice-expressive-default-off`

`server/voice/voices.js expressiveOn`: DragonHD's per-clause SSML plan only with `TAXILA_VOICE_EXPRESSIVE=1` (or on / dhd / all). Before, it was on unless set to 0, against `rj-ssml-delivery-plan-2026-10-04` (2.10 vs 2.40, choppy / slow). Main's decision on audit V-27, listed for the owner in `docs/design/round7/audit/voice-proposals.md`.

**Reverse if** a blind listen on children's lines prefers the planned SSML.

## `dc-r7-audit-voice-deleted-compilers`

Removed in the voice audit's deletion commit (RULES2: nothing live reads them; no `context/` entry cites them as evidence):

- `server/voice/expressive/compile/mai.js` (the MAI voice compiler): last held at `634e125b`.
- `server/voice/expressive/compile/omni.js` (the DragonHD Omni compiler): last held at `634e125b`.

Their one test (`tests/voice-expressive-align.test.mjs`, "the other compilers") keeps its oai half. The rest of V-39 and all of V-37 stay, with the reason for each in `docs/design/round7/audit/voice-proposals.md` §3-4.

**Reverse if** an MAI or Omni voice is chosen for a lane: restore from `634e125b`.
md.open:
## `fd-r7-audit-voice-switch-translit-not-wired`

Record correction (audit V-29). `rs7-voice-switch` and `rs7-translit-roman-to-devanagari` read as shipped steps; neither is called by any live path (`voice-switch.js` styleFor / synthesize, `translit/index.js` toDevanagari are reached only from tests and evals). Main decided not to wire them now. One data fix landed: `bara` is no longer a hand entry for twelve (`sabse bara` would have become `सबसे बारह`); NUMBER_AMBIG still reads it as twelve in a run of numbers.
